region: Singapore (with Southeast & South Asia deployment scope)
notes: MAS sustainable finance page reports: Green Investments Partnership achieved first close with US$510 million of committed capital from global/regional private, public and philanthropic institutions, to be deployed into green and sustainable infrastructure in Southeast and South Asia; UK pledged up to £70 million to Singapore's Financing Asia's Transition Partnership (FAST-P); Energy Transition Acceleration Finance (ETAF) partnership aims to mobilise capital for earlier-stage/higher-risk energy transition infrastructure; appointment of MAS Chief Sustainability Officer from 6 October 2025 announced; 3rd Singapore-China Green Finance Taskforce meeting held.
recommended_action: Offer HydraShield's climate risk intelligence and exposure analytics as a due-diligence and portfolio-monitoring layer for FAST-P/GIP-backed infrastructure investors and Singapore-based green finance institutions.
